SYMPTOM: Claude CLI crashes with 'An unknown error occurred (Unexpected)' after running for a while. Requires computer restart to fix. ulimit fix (ulimit -n 2147483646) doesn't prevent recurrence.

CAUSE: Every UserPromptSubmit fires a bun process for the hook. Every session end fires bun for curation. The curation process spawns Claude via Agent SDK which spawns more processes. Over time: fd leaks, zombie processes, bun runtime state corrupts. macOS default 256 fd limit makes it worse.

FIX: Rewrite hooks as plain shell scripts using curl + python3 (system binaries, can't crash Claude). Started in:
- .claude/hooks/user-prompt-submit.sh
- .claude/hooks/session-end.sh
NOT YET COMPLETED — settings.json not updated to use new scripts.

PREVENT: No bun in the hook hot path. Hooks should be curl one-liners that call localhost:8765.
